description: One-call visibility audit for a public website: Sellular visibility score (0-100, A-F) and whether llms.txt exists (root or .well-known). For a domain we already list, also the tracked directories in its category with no known listing. That last field is ABSENT for any other domain, deliberately: we hold no submission records for sites we do not list, so there is nothing to report and a guess would read as a finding. Read-only; results cached 24h per domain. Use when asked to audit or size up a site's overall discoverability in one shot.

domain.description: A domain (example.com) or full URL to scan.

name: scan_domain
